decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already moves the SPS30 I2C requirement from the sensor-board context to the integrated board without changing its SEL or I2C-mode rules.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes obsolete main-to-sensor-board inputs, retains the external module connectors, and moves the requirement to the integrated-board context.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records removal of the modular interboard interface and deletes its obsolete connector, topology, and pinout attributes.
The existing same-message MODIFY already relocates the pull-ups to the integrated board, removes the obsolete interboard-cable attribute, and updates scope.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records that a separate sensor-board production package is obsolete and removes the old board-specific package attributes.
The existing same-message MODIFY directly captures the client's approval to place connectors across the proposed board sides as needed.

The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete separate-power-board activation condition and moves the requirement to the integrated-board context without inventing a replacement power rule.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates measurement coverage and scope from the former sensor-board topology to sensors and LEDs on the integrated board.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the three-board enclosure inventory and mounting description with one integrated board plus external sensors, buttons, LEDs, and the battery.
The AXP2101 requirement was already scoped to the integrated board, and the connector-placement decision does not change its battery, USB, charging, or rail behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY already moves the unchanged BOOT and reset circuit requirement from the modular main board to the integrated-board context.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete modular-main-board scope while preserving the unchanged ESP32 module and breakout requirements on the integrated board.
